done_when: Close starts the review at the same time as its tests, so a round takes about as long as the slower of the two; a red test or a P0/P1 finding still stops the round, and both results are reported together. New and existing client repos get it on init or upgrade plus sync, and a test covers both.

findings.body: Raise: Gate. `close.py` now gives the reviewer a pending notice and prints the completed test result afterward. The unchanged `tests/test_fix_close_runs_fast_test_instead_of_test.py:52` still requires `"1 passed"` in the review prompt, so its `test_2_close_runs_the_full_custom_command_when_fast_test_is_unset` case fails. The recorded full-suite failure confirms this assertion, and `.github/workflows/forge.yml:39` runs that suite for the pull request.
findings.title: Full test suite fails on an unchanged review-prompt assertion
